slides.title: The monthly build night of *Builders.*
slides.subtitle: Founders and young technical talent, building AI ventures through the night.

slides.title: The Builders studio, compressed into *one night.*
slides.body: The same room, the same people and the same bias for shipping, once a month in Rotterdam.

slides.title: Two types of people in the room

points.title: Founders
points.body: With an idea or an early product, looking for the people to build it with.

points.title: Builders
points.body: Engineers, designers and makers early in their careers who would rather ship than talk.

points.title: One theme
points.body: A topic or industry that decides what gets built.

points.title: One guest
points.body: A person who can speak for that theme.

points.title: Teams
points.body: Founders and builders pair up in the room.

slides.title: Something that runs, *not a deck.*
slides.body: The goal of the night is a working first version of an AI venture, built by the people who will carry it on.

slides.title: From edition 03, every night has a *theme* and a *guest.*
What we ask of a guest

points.title: Bring the theme
points.body: Speak for the topic or industry the night is about.

points.title: Be in the room
points.body: Founders and builders get to ask you what they need to know to build.

points.title: Get pixelated
points.body: Your portrait becomes the arcade avatar on the cover and the posts.
